questions.question: What did Ezekiel do with his hair as a sign in chapter 5?
options: Buried it down by the river until at last it rotted
Shaved it, then burned, struck, and scattered it
Offered it all up as a sacrifice upon the altar
Wove it into a belt and wore it daily about him
questions.answer: Shaved it, then burned, struck, and scattered it

questions.question: What did the divided hair represent?
options: The number of years remaining until the long exile would end
The three great kingdoms that would one day conquer Judah
The small number of the righteous still left within the city
The fate of Jerusalem's people: plague, sword, and scattering
questions.answer: The fate of Jerusalem's people: plague, sword, and scattering
